status_summary: H.R. 1125, the LOCAL Act, was introduced in the House on 2025-02-07 and referred to the Committee on Natural Resources; Section 3 would place the BLM headquarters in Grand Junction, Colorado, and Section 4 would require a Secretary of the Interior study of relocating more positions, with a report within 365 days of enactment. Its GovInfo status record shows 17 cosponsors and no action after the referral. No Secretary's order, announcement or Federal Register notice moving the headquarters was found through October 2026.
